brief.label: Storage and logistics
brief.heading: The client
paras: Storage Hire offers managed storage in Harlow, Essex. Their team looks after your things, rather than handing you a padlock and a corridor. Terms are weekly or monthly, with no long contract.

answer.label: Storage, Essex
answer.heading: What we built
paras: A Wix site, designed and built around local search. It carries LocalBusiness and OfferCatalog structured data, the quiet markup that helps a local business turn up when someone nearby goes looking.
We have not published the scope, the timeline or any results for this one. When there are numbers we can stand behind, they will go here.
